messages.greeting: Hello! I can help you find government schemes you may qualify for. I will ask a few questions, and you can skip any of them.
messages.confirm_inferred: I understood your {label} as {value}, but you did not say this directly. Is that correct? (yes/no)
messages.rejected_inferred: Okay, I will not use that.
messages.conflict: You gave two different answers for {label}. Please tell me the correct one.
messages.income_whose: You mentioned an amount of {amount}. Is this your family's income or your own income?
messages.skipped: Okay, I will skip that question.
messages.nothing_understood: Sorry, I could not understand that answer.
messages.skip_hint: You can type "skip" if you prefer not to answer.
messages.optional_hint: This question is optional. You can type "skip".
messages.show_results: Thank you. I have enough for a first check. Here are your results.
messages.restarted: Okay, I have cleared your answers. Let us start again.
messages.text_too_long: That message is too long. Please keep it under {limit} characters.
messages.preliminary_notice: This is a preliminary check based only on what you told us. It is not an official decision. Please confirm on the official portal before you apply.

questions.state_code: Which state or union territory do you live in?
questions.domicile_state_code: Which state is your domicile (your permanent home state)?
questions.study_state_code: In which state do you study?
questions.annual_family_income: What is your family's total income for one year?
questions.annual_individual_income: What is your own income for one year?
questions.is_enrolled_in_education: Are you currently studying at a school, college or other institution? (yes/no)
questions.has_bank_account: Do you have a bank account? (yes/no)
questions.receives_other_scholarship: Do you already receive another scholarship? (yes/no)
questions.gender: What is your gender? (woman, man or other)
questions.social_category: Which social category do you belong to? (SC, ST, OBC, EWS or General)
questions.is_or_was_income_tax_payer: Are you, or have you ever been, an income-tax payer? (yes/no)

labels.is_or_was_income_tax_payer: Is or has been an income-tax payer

states.DH: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

explain.notice: This is a preliminary check based only on what you told us and on the published rules we have recorded. It is not an official decision and does not mean the government has approved your application. Please confirm on the official portal before you apply.

reasons.record_is_draft: Our record of this scheme has not been verified against an official source yet.
reasons.no_rules: We have no verified eligibility rules recorded for this scheme.
reasons.rules_incomplete: Our record may not list every official condition.
reasons.record_stale: Our record is overdue for a re-check against the official source.
reasons.official_only_rules: Some conditions can only be confirmed by the official authority.
reasons.scheme_status_closed: This scheme is recorded as closed.
reasons.scheme_status_suspended: This scheme is recorded as suspended.
reasons.scheme_status_unknown: We could not confirm that this scheme is currently active.
reasons.deadline_passed: The recorded application deadline has passed.
reasons.confirm_other_conditions: This scheme has other official conditions that we cannot check from your answers; see the list below.

result.meets: {label}{as_of}: you said {given}; requirement: {req}. This is met.
result.fails: {label}{as_of}: you said {given}; requirement: {req}. This is not met.
result.missing: {label}: not provided; requirement: {req}. We need this to decide; we have not assumed it is met.
result.invalid: {label}: the answer given ({given}) could not be used; requirement: {req}.
result.age_depends: {label}{as_of}: you could be {ages} on that date depending on your birthday; requirement: {req}. Your date of birth would settle it.
result.official_only: {label}: requirement: {req}. This cannot be checked from your answers; confirm it with the official authority.
result.not_verified: {label}: requirement: {req}. This rule has not been verified against an official source yet.
result.excl_rule: The scheme excludes people whose answer {cond}.
result.excl_not_applies: {label}{as_of}: {given}. {rule} The exclusion does not apply to you.
result.excl_missing: {label}: not provided. {rule} We need this to decide; we have not assumed the exclusion does not apply.
result.excl_invalid: {label}: the answer given ({given}) could not be used. {rule}
result.excl_official_only: {label}: {rule} This cannot be checked from your answers; confirm it with the official authority.
result.excl_not_verified: {label}: {rule} This rule has not been verified against an official source yet.
